, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the director of “I Love, You Love” as Alain Resnais based on misleading search snippets without verifying the film’s actual page. The film “I Love, You Love” (Ja milujem, ty miluješ) was directed by Dušan Hanák, so pursuing Alain Resnais’s birthplace led the workflow down the wrong path.
